preconditions.name: ARM_1_JOINT::joint_route_range_supra_floor
preconditions.description: JOINT routed per-candidate coherence cross-candidate RANGE (modulatory_channel_route_range on the coherence source, pre-rescale) clears the floor on >= MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS seeds. This is the SAME-STATISTIC safeguard (skill 643 rule): C1/C2 gate on a RANK readout (committed-class TV), which is invariant under a broadcast additive constant -- exactly the 661 scalar-coherence null. A committed-TV difference is a claim result ONLY IF the routed coherence is a genuine supra-floor cross-candidate RANGE, not a rescale-invisible scalar. measured is the MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS-th largest per-seed route_range_mean (order statistic matching the count quantifier). Below floor => the manipulation cannot move committed behaviour => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a substrate verdict.
preconditions.control: JOINT: all four V_s-gated streams co-bound -> compose_per_candidate_coherence full cross-candidate range; 2026-06-19 smoke measured JOINT range 0.1 vs a 0.01 floor (~10x headroom)

preconditions.name: ARM_1_JOINT::adequate_fresh_selection_sample
preconditions.description: JOINT recorded >= FRESH_SELECT_FLOOR genuine E3 select() calls on the CORRECTED denominator (diagnostics cleared before every select_action, so a latched tick contributes NO row) on >= MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS seeds, so the route_range readiness estimate is real and not ~9x pseudo-replicated. Floor 3600/beta_rate_max_steps=20 = 180, the MECH-093-modulated worst-case cadence. measured is the MIN_SEEDS_FOR_PASS-th largest per-seed n_fresh_select (order statistic matching the count quantifier).
preconditions.control: nominal window P1*(steps-measure_after)=3600 ticks at the MECH-093 worst-case cadence beta_rate_max_steps=20 -> 180 selections

preconditions.name: ARM_1_JOINT::candidate_first_action_diversity_supra_floor
preconditions.description: Worst packet-ON cell's mean number of distinct candidate first-action classes > 1.0. The per-candidate coherence gate RANKS candidates by their co-bound action alignment; if the SP-CEM proposer emits a single first-action class the gate has nothing to rank and the committed-TV readout cannot move regardless of binding mode (memo honest-limitation: 'the validation must guard candidate first-action diversity'). This is the positive control that the routed statistic CAN be non-degenerate. measured is the WORST cell (all(...) quantifier), offending cell named.
preconditions.control: SP-CEM with support_preserving_min_first_action_classes=2 stratifies elites to keep >= 2 first-action classes in the candidate pool

preconditions.name: ARM_1_JOINT::adequate_committed_window_sample
preconditions.description: Worst packet-ON cell recorded >= COMMITTED_WINDOW_FLOOR committed actions in the measurement window (n_p1_ticks_past_window). This is the C1/C2 DV denominator (the HELD action is the committed behaviour across latched ticks, so the committed-class histogram is a per-env-step behavioural readout). A cell with too few committed observations gives an under-powered TV estimate. measured is the WORST cell (all(...) quantifier), offending cell named.
preconditions.control: nominal window 3600 env steps; early-`done` truncation reduces it, so a per-cell floor guards the TV estimate

evidence_direction_note: [2026-09-09 governance, cycle governance-20260909 wave 5] Re-dispositioned weakens -> non_contributory (GFLAG-0183, user-adjudicated at the /governance walk). Grounds, verified this cycle rather than taken on report: this run was measured with the ARC-065 SP-CEM candidate pool pinned at its floor -- driver line 485 sets support_preserving_min_first_action_classes=2, and the run's own recorded worst_diversity_joint / worst_diversity_alt / worst_diversity_shuf are all 2.0022, i.e. sitting exactly at that floor -- against the mean_distinct_first_action_classes >= 4.5 that this lineage's own falsifier (MECH-341, claims.yaml falsifying route (i)) treats as a GENUINELY DIVERSE pool. A weakens collected at a floor-clamped pool is not evidence that the binding mechanism fails; it is a run in which the mechanism was never given a pool to bind over, so the result cannot discriminate. ATTRIBUTION CORRECTION to GFLAG-0183's own wording: the >= 4.5 figure is MECH-341's stated bar, not ARC-065's -- ARC-065's record carries no such number. What line 485 supplies is the ARC-065 SP-CEM clamp at 2, which is the verified half. Retest needs the pool raised to >= 4.5 with the substrate measured operative. Not dry (verified). Written to the flat manifest AND the run pack, since the claims.yaml edit does not reach the scoring path.
